title: Emergency response briefing
prompt: A local response team is coordinating around a major storm outage. Which updates should be surfaced first for the next decision window?

contributions.body: Medical device outages should be elevated first because the harm of delay is immediate and severe.
A plain thread still needs logistics updates, but it makes it harder to separate truly urgent items from noisy status updates.
The shift handoff is where a plain thread starts to hurt, because the next operator has to reconstruct the briefing manually.

responses.body: The baseline is still useful as a control, but it leaves too much triage work to the reader.
